replies.author: Zedther
replies.body:
Hey there, ShouDi.
We greatly appreciate your concern, and thanks for your report.
However, at the moment Bloodoh is not eligible for a punishment for his infractions, as he was
only recently punished for excessive infractions, and is not eligible for a permanent ban until he 
gains at least 8 more infractions. 

If you or anyone else sees Bloodoh breaking the rules, you are more than welcome to submit a report
here.

Thanks again c:
-Zedther
